provenance.source: Income Tax Act (British Columbia); CRA T4127 Chapter 8 (British Columbia); BC indexation factor 2.2% for 2026
provenance.notes: Brackets and BPA are the 2025 amounts indexed at 2.2% and rounded to the dollar. NOT verified against T4127 - this file is the single place to correct it.

medical.note: The BC threshold differs slightly from the federal one. The federal figure is used as an approximation pending verification.

omissions: The BC tax reduction credit for low incomes is not modelled, so low incomes are overstated.
MSP premiums were eliminated in 2020 and are correctly absent.
